sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In Save the Dummy, the core gameplay revolves around drawing lines and shapes to create a path for the Stickman to escape. The game features a range of scenarios, each with its unique challenges and obstacles. To progress through the game, you'll need to use your creativity and problem-solving skills to navigate the Stickman through these challenges.

The game's controls are simple and intuitive, allowing you to draw lines and shapes with ease. On PC, you can use the mouse to draw, while on mobile devices, you can use your finger to create lines and shapes on the screen. The game's physics engine ensures that your drawings are accurate and precise, making it easy to create complex paths and shapes.

As you progress through the game, you'll encounter various power-ups and obstacles that will aid or hinder your progress.
